rules: Reference fixture lead names, company values, blocker text and dates are never copied into runtime state or submitted to the API.
Current lead, client, case and workspace IDs are read from existing runtime owners and preserved in the task/activity payload.
Missing/blocker records use the existing task/activity source of truth; case_items remain legacy/checklist compatibility and are not a parallel active store.
Unsupported responsible-person and client-decision persistence is explicitly disabled with contract copy rather than faked.
Every semantic color resolves from the canonical --cf-vst-* token owner; reference-image discrepancies never create per-screen color exceptions.
The delete semantic base is --cf-vst-color-delete; strong, soft and border variants derive from it, and every trash icon resolves to that family.
No fake success, no-op persistence model, automatic merge, silent fallback, unapproved browser mutation or production merge was introduced.

color_source_of_truth.policy: One semantic concern maps to one VST token owner across every window and repeated component instance; all trash/delete icons share the same semantic delete family.

visible_controls_wired: The real Lead Detail Brak action opens the modal; title, category, description, priority, due date and blocking scope are validated and mapped to the existing task/activity mutation. Save emits the existing saved-record event; LeadDetail accepts it only with matching lead and workspace relations, locally prepends the task and silently reloads the real source.
unsupported_controls: Odpowiedzialny is visible but disabled because the current contract has no first-class assignment persistence field.
